spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact nullable contract (CSSOM styleSheet: CSSStyleSheet?) via real @import … supports() rules written into a live style element, with CSS Cascade 5 conditional-import semantics explained against the readout.

interactive.rationale: Condition select + custom condition input + inject button drive a real CSSOM round-trip; readout, proof card and verdict all rebuild from live values on every run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises writing a conditional import and reading supportsText/styleSheet/paint back; the page does exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers true conditions, parenthesized false conditions (Chromium 141 wrongly fetches these — surfaced with its own verdict branch), declaration-form false conditions (141 drops the rule entirely), unparseable custom conditions, and a settle window so a pending null is never misread as nullable behavior.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5123480866783232, the CSSOM interface section, Cascade 5 conditional imports, and CL 5065830.

conformance.rationale: New feature-level 6-assertion suite probes the exact contracts (rule retention, null for false supports, null after failed load, SameObject loaded sheet, prototype getter, supportsText); verified executing 4 pass / 2 honest fails on pre-158 Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud container): all three condition paths exercised with correct verdicts, zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow desktop and mobile, screenshots read. Partial, not pass: the Chrome 158 nullable success path cannot run on this 141 build and stays pinned by the conformance suite.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts readout consistency (painted implies non-null styleSheet) on every run plus an explicit branch-recording assert for false conditions; console output is two intentional log lines.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, dark buttons keep explicit light text, verdict/readout pairs meet AA (emerald/rose on paper, charcoal on stone), [hidden] guard added so display:grid cannot resurrect hidden fields.

accessibility.rationale: Native select/input/button with visible labels, aria-describedby hint on the custom field, single aria-live=polite output per stage, dl readout with named dt/dd pairs, focus visible on native controls.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Repo harness mobile 360×740 DPR3 + desktop 1280×800: no horizontal overflow (0px both), 44px control heights, wrapping readout values via overflow-wrap:anywhere; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Verify the nullable path on a real Chrome 158 build
openQuestions.detail: This container's Chromium 141 shows the legacy behaviors (declaration-form rule drop; parenthesized-form wrong fetch with non-null styleSheet). On a 158+ build, verify the false-supports verdict flips to the modern branch (rule retained, styleSheet === null, nothing fetched) and the conformance suite reaches 6/6.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates async results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region per changing surface; announce meaningful results, not interstitial noise; assertive only for critical failures.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The stage routes its settle-complete summary through a single aria-live=polite <output>; the verdict paragraph is plain text updated with it; no loading-spam announcements during the poll window.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic sizing (flex-wrap + minmax) rather than fixed columns; let long tokens wrap.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap with flex-basis 16rem fields; readout dd cells use overflow-wrap:anywhere and min-width:0; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Live conditional-import lab over the exact nullable styleSheet contract. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this cloud container): true condition fetches/applies/exposes the sheet, parenthesized false condition exposes 141's wrong fetch with an honest legacy verdict, declaration-form false condition exposes 141's rule drop; consoles clean, no network failures, overflow 0 both classes.
